phoneCautions: Uniform subintervals excluded (вронская both, бедная both, блестящей control); prolonged /j/ in гордые both also needs audit, excluded from phoneme metric. One /n:/ in анна maps to the two-letter нн group; no manual seam between two н glyphs exists.
notesCaution: Published note labels are realistic music-score annotations; do not treat every note_start/note_end as an independent exact performed-note truth or compare phoneme pitch to them blindly.
listenReference: The corpus authors report independent listening and spectrogram review. This agent obtained their annotations rather than claiming to have listened.
